title: Why do zebras have stripes?
examples: Do zebras use their stripes for anything?
Are the stripes just for looks?
Why do some animals have stripes?

explain.say: Zebras have black and white stripes. Scientists have some ideas about why.
One idea is that the stripes confuse animals that hunt zebras.
Another idea is about heat. The stripes may help a zebra stay cool.
The strongest idea is about flies. Biting flies find it hard to land on stripes.
Picture a big crowd of zebras. All the stripes blend together, so it is hard to pick out one.
A common mistake is to think stripes are only for hiding in grass. Stripes may help in many ways.

items: It is not just about hiding

faq.q: Do all zebras have the same stripes?
faq.a: No. Every zebra has its own stripe pattern.
asks: Are all zebra stripes the same?

faq.q: Do the stripes help them swim?
faq.a: Stripes are thought to help on land. For example, they may keep biting flies away.
asks: Are stripes useful in the river?
Do stripes help when they swim?

faq.q: Are the stripes a warning sign?
faq.a: For zebras, the main ideas are keeping flies away, staying cool and confusing hunters.
asks: Do the stripes warn others away?

faq.q: Do the stripes help them find food?
faq.a: No, the stripes are not really for finding food. They are more about keeping them safe from other animals.
asks: Is finding food related to stripes?

faq.q: Why are they black and white?
faq.a: Scientists are still finding out. Black and white stripes seem to confuse biting flies.
asks: What makes the colors so clear?

facts: Zebra stripes seem to stop biting flies from landing.
The stripes may also help the zebra to regulate its body temperature.
The pattern is unique to each individual zebra.

quiz.say: Scientists have a strong idea about zebra stripes. What might they keep away?
quiz.why: Biting flies find it hard to land on stripes.

wrong.0: Rain falls on zebras whatever their coat looks like.
wrong.2: Zebras like to live together in big groups.

quiz.say: One idea is that stripes help in the hot sun. How might they help?
quiz.why: One idea is that the stripes help a zebra stay cool.

wrong.1: Strong legs make a zebra fast, and stripes add no speed.
wrong.2: Zebras find water by walking to rivers and pools they know.

quiz.say: Many zebras stand together. Why might a lion find it hard to pick one?
quiz.why: Lots of stripes side by side make it hard to see where one zebra ends.

wrong.0: Zebras are easy to see, but the stripes blend together.
wrong.1: Zebras in a group often stay alert.
